CustomField.description: Sum of hard-credit giving from legacy or external systems (archived CRM, spreadsheet migration, prior fundraising platform). Populated once during import and preserved thereafter — NPC rollups do not touch this field. FQS donor-grouping formulas add this to the standard TotalGiftsAmount rollup so migrated donors retain their true lifetime giving picture. Leave blank for donors with no pre-system giving history.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Total hard-credit giving from a legacy or external system. Adds to the standard TotalGiftsAmount rollup for donor-grouping calculations.
CustomField.label: Legacy Total Gifts Amount
